prompt:
Original instrumental opening underscore exclusively for HOS 009 The Falling Moon, Newton connecting an apple with the Moon. Intimate period chamber music led by soft gut-string lute and lightly articulated viol answers. Wonder comes from space between short, gently changing phrases and warm harmony, not a continuous bass drone. Keep a quiet audible musical bed beneath the sparse phrases, with subtle variation in register and voicing. Begin softly but clearly, already in the musical scene; no long fade-up, dramatic swell or opening sting. At about 84 seconds soften into an intimate orchard mood. End with a quiet sustained harmonic handoff suitable for a three-second crossfade into the existing D-minor harpsichord teach cue. Leave ample space for British narration; no foreground tune.
Pace: 60-66 BPM, spacious phrasing; no driving ostinato.
NOT any earlier HOS or Orbit bed, the previous HOS009 wonder cue, jupiter-music.mp3, sustained bass-drone opening, cosmic shimmer, piano space-documentary music, solo woodwind workshop waltz, borrowed melody, named-composer imitation, heroic brass, horror, vocals, lyrics, pop drums, EDM or comedy stings.
